dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with high-contrast, jagged light-colored perimeters surrounding dark centers; the most distinct structures are concentrated along the upper-central dorsal ridge showing sharp gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity punctate blobs lacking internal gradients, primarily clustered in the anterior-dorsal region and becoming sparser toward the posterior and lateral edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while smaller high-intensity blobs form an irregular linear chain extending toward the anterior neck region.
